prompt: I was charged twice for my subscription. What do I do?
response: I can help you sort that out. Please send the dates and amounts of the two charges. I’ll use those details to identify the duplicate and explain the next step.

prompt: How do I cancel my account?
response: You can cancel from Settings > Billing > Cancel subscription. Your access will remain active through the end of the current billing period.
Use the Forgot password link on the sign-in page. We’ll email you a reset link. If it doesn’t arrive within a few minutes, check spam or tell me the email domain you use and I’ll help troubleshoot.

A decline can come from your bank, an expired card, an incorrect billing address, or a temporary authorization issue. First check the card details and billing address, then try once more. If it still fails, contact your bank or use another payment method.

prompt: Where can I download my invoices?
response: Open Settings > Billing > Invoices. You can view or download each invoice as a PDF.

A temporary lock usually follows several unsuccessful sign-in attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again, or reset your password. If the account remains locked, contact support so we can verify ownership and restore access.
Refund eligibility depends on the purchase and billing terms. Send me the charge date and what you purchased, and I’ll help determine the applicable option.

prompt: How do I update my card?
response: Go to Settings > Billing > Payment method, choose Update, and enter the new card details. The new payment method will be used for future renewals.
